response.sql:
WITH item_quantities AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4)) AS quantity
  FROM Order_Items
),
order_averages AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity
  FROM item_quantities
  GROUP BY order_id
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS baseline_avg
  FROM order_averages
)
SELECT
  oa.order_id,
  oa.avg_quantity,
  oa.avg_quantity - b.baseline_avg AS difference
FROM order_averages AS oa
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but represents numeric quantities, so the query casts it to DECIMAL before averaging; nonnumeric values may fail or be coerced depending on the SQL dialect.
